deferrals.reason: openhands-sdk 1.50.1 requires fastmcp>=3.2.0,<4, which requires mcp<2. Defer MCP 2.x until a supported SDK/fastmcp release removes that constraint.
openhands-sdk が Python 3.14 を未検証のため保留（requires-python >=3.12, CI は 3.12）。SDK のサポート範囲が 3.14 を含む版へ更新する際に再検討。

The circuit-server image is assembled by the upstream agent-server build (sdk:openhands-agent-server/1.50.1); its .venv, nodejs_wheel node_modules, and Docker CLI plugins carry ~70 upstream-borne Trivy findings currently covered by expiring .trivyignore waivers. Defer the bump until its changelog review confirms compatibility, then re-scan and drop cleared waivers.
